following: Repeated validation
Seeds 42 to 47 allocate predictor groups to 20 percent assessment, then divide development 70/15/15 into fitting, utility and calibration, and selection.

Fitting alone determines caps, weights, transformations, maps, and base models (Figure 1). Utility and calibration fit gates and flat meta controls. Selection chooses settings and unknown thresholds. Assessment outcomes determine none of them.

preceding: Experimental design and analysis tiers

Table 3 separates primary, mechanism, robustness, boundary, and exploratory tests. Negative evidence from any category can constrain conclusions. Post review additions are identified rather than described as preregistered.
Table 3. Evidence tiers and analysis plan
following: Models and comparators
Weighted multiclass XGBoost is the principal flat model (Chen & Guestrin, 2016); LightGBM supplies family and local components (Ke et al., 2017). Appendix A lists frozen constructors.

Comparators include weighted and unweighted trees, ordinary and temperature calibrated flat blends, a converged Newton Cholesky stacker, hard and soft taxonomy models, and resampling variants. Convergence diagnostics are retained. Tree budgets are matched only where stated, without implying equal parameter counts.
